sections.title: Introduction: Navigating Uncertainty: Prepare Without Overreacting
sections.summary: Emphasizes avoiding headline-driven reactions and sticking to time-tested principles; notes AI is more likely than politics to shape 2026 macro outcomes.

sections.title: The Dollar’s Decline: Implications of a Weaker USD for Investors
sections.summary: Only nine of 34 tracked currencies are more overvalued than the USD; consider modest reallocation to non-US assets and measured currency hedging based on local rates.

sections.title: AI Arms Race: The Biggest Buildout You Never Saw Coming
sections.summary: Hyperscalers are investing heavily in AI infrastructure; AI-linked sector valuations are elevated, and broad US equity indexes already carry significant AI exposure.

sections.title: Beyond the Magnificent Seven: Unlocking Value in a Concentrated Market
sections.summary: Rising concentration risk argues for diversification; US small caps and select international markets offer better valuations and broader return drivers.

sections.title: Investing for Income in an Uncertain Market
sections.summary: Intermediate-term bonds look like the sweet spot; credit spreads are tight; UK and Brazilian equities stand out for attractive income yields.

sections.title: Beyond the Budget, Black Holes, and Brexit—Investing in UK Assets
sections.summary: UK equities trade at a deep discount to US peers with high dividends; roughly 80% of UK Index revenues come from abroad; UK government bond yields are the highest in the G7.

sections.title: Retirement Investing in Australia: Meeting Today’s Needs Without Sacrificing Tomorrow
sections.summary: Balance income, inflation protection, and capital stability; sequencing and longevity risks call for dynamic allocation; super funds enable access to unlisted, inflation-linked assets.

sections.title: US Outlook: Private Markets Go Mainstream
sections.summary: Semiliquid structures expand access to private assets; adding 5%–10% diversified private exposure can raise median lifetime returns, but higher costs, less transparency, and liquidity limits matter.

sections.title: South Africa: A Hidden Gem in Emerging Markets
sections.summary: After sentiment-driven gains in precious-metals miners, diversified global miners look more attractive; local banks offer ~8% expected real returns; SA equities are priced for higher expected returns than EM/DM peers.

sections.title: Asia Outlook: China’s Quiet Reset
sections.summary: Policy shifts to curb overcapacity create complexity; specialist managers’ varied positioning highlights uncertainty but potential for long-term returns.

sections.title: Disclosures
sections.summary: General information-only disclaimer; risk warnings; conflicts-of-interest and distribution notes; index and forward-looking statement caveats.
